reviewNote: Historical text for a deliberately narrow set of Section 135 fragments. Text and interval dates were checked by an AI coding assistant against the sources listed here on 2026-09-28; this is source-verified engineering data, not a lawyer-reviewed statement of law. Only fragments are recorded: other parts of Section 135 changed on other dates (for example Act 1 of 2018 amended sub-section (1) with effect from 19-9-2018) and are intentionally absent, so questions about them must not be answered from this file. An open-ended interval means no later version is recorded in the consulted sources (latest consolidation consulted: last update 29-7-2022), not that the text is verified as current.

fragments.heading: Corporate Social Responsibility
fragments.label: sub-section (6): Unspent Corporate Social Responsibility Account for ongoing projects

evidence.excerpt: appoints the 22nd day of January, 2021 as the date on which the provisions of section 21 of the said Act shall come into force.

versions.text: (6) Any amount remaining unspent under sub-section (5), pursuant to any ongoing project, fulfilling such conditions as may be prescribed, undertaken by a company in persuance of its Corporate Social Responsibility Policy, shall be transferred by the company within a period of thirty days from the end of the financial year to a special account to be opened by the company in that behalf for that financial year in any scheduled bank to be called the Unspent Corporate Social Responsibility Account, and such amount shall be spent by the company in pursuance of its obligation towards the Corporate Social Responsibility Policy within a period of three financial years from the date of such transfer, failing which, the company shall transfer the same to a Fund specified in Schedule VII, within a period of thirty days from the date of completion of the third financial year.
